items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the transcript. The interviewer mentions 'Daniel Bach was playing with Lucky Mill' and 'I could be used to go to Danny's house', but the interviewee provides no response or confirmation of a personal relationship.

ctx.x: Where's that? Daniel. That's right. Yeah, they were playing that banjo there. Kimball. That's a bunch of better banjo. Joyce Gannon.
That's right. But the guitar took it, taking everything away from him.
